licensePolicy: Only verified recordings with explicit open licenses (CC0, CC-BY-4.0, or licensed offline TTS models) may be mapped to learner items. Synthetic/placeholder tones are strictly forbidden for vocabulary or radical entries.

coverageSummary.statusNote: No offline Mandarin TTS voice pack (zh-CN/cmn) or licensed human audio corpus is bundled in the local environment. All learner items use Tier-1 audioUrl when populated by backend/manifest, falling back to Tier-2 Web Speech API (when a Chinese voice is available on the device) or Tier-3 explicit user notification.
